scene: Inside the antique shop, three strange transit portals wait.
picture: A flat side view of a cluttered antique transit parlour. On the far left, a polished brass funicular car sits with open doors. Left of centre, an elderly East Asian man in a blue flat cap and orange cardigan stands with a wooden cane. Centre rests an ornate pedal rickshaw. Far right waits a red monorail.
shown: a brass funicular railway car waiting with doors open on the far left
a pedal rickshaw with a velvet seat waiting silently in the centre
a sleek red monorail carriage resting at an indoor boarding gate far right

variants.scene: Clocks tick softly beside three unusual ways to travel.
